oneLiner: Backend for spec billing-downgrade-v2: API, scheduled job, and migration; portal UI deferred per §5.
requirementSummary: Spec billing-downgrade-v2 §3 requires self-service downgrade API, proration as internal credit, and application at billing cycle end; §5 portal UI is SHOULD and may ship in a sibling MR.

integration.summary: billing-api exposes downgrade per §3.1; Postgres holds scheduled changes; billing-jobs worker applies at boundary and enqueues confirmation mail. Stripe used read-only for subscription lookup.
integration.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Client[Clients] --> API[billing-api §3.1]
  API --> DB[(scheduled changes)]
  Job[billing-jobs §3.3] --> DB
  Job --> Mail[email queue]
integration.mermaidSequence:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant API as billing-api
  participant DB as Postgres
  participant Job as billing-jobs
  participant Mail as email queue
  Client->>API: POST downgrade
  API->>DB: insert scheduled change
  API-->>Client: pending + credit preview
  Job->>DB: due rows at cycle end
  Job->>API: apply plan change
  Job->>Mail: confirmation (once)
